skills-buffs-status.notes: Every level-up and reroll performs an original-style weighted draw without replacement, filtering by times, used-hero range, account hero star, recovered wave conditions, and current base HP. The initial level-up draw has no minimum-quality guarantee; only reroll enforces minimum quality 4 (purple). Thirty-three original effect rows participate as twenty-nine mutually exclusive ability groups: twenty-eight active groups plus the evidence-confirmed v18 REWARD/3012 no-op. RG_ALL_abl10_eff01 upgrades one random placed non-power gear. RG_ALL_abl07_eff01 multiplies later EXP notifications by 1.5. RG_ALL_abl08_eff01 applies live enemy ATK_DEC. RG_ALL_abl12_eff01 gives future HAMSTER/WHEEL outputs from directly adjacent core gears a 1.2 attack multiplier. RG_ALL_abl16_eff01 gives the same direct-neighbor scope 1.2 worker progress and displayed rate. RG_ALL_abl17_eff01 is a noRestore immediate consumable available at 0%-50% base HP; it heals floor(max HP * 0.5), clamps to max, and does not persist in the trait stack. RG_ALL_abl18_eff01 is a one-time persistent ability available at 0%-75% base HP; it does not heal on selection and restores floor(max HP * 0.1), capped to max, on every later BAGLIKE_BATTLE_ROUND_START. RG_H01_abl02 selects only the highest H01-star-qualified row at 3/5/8/10 stars and grants future H01 units the recovered 3/3/2/2-completion forced-critical passive. RG_H12_abl01 selects the highest H12-star-qualified row at 1/3 stars, replacing LY_1201 with LY_1202/LY_1203 and applying one/two-second dizziness to the primary random target while preserving delayed area damage and control immunity. RG_H12_abl02 requires H12 star 2 and adds CRI_RATE 10000; RG_H12_abl03 requires star 7 and adds CRI_DMG 5000 to the H12/H08 scope. RG_H12_abl04 requires star 10 and replaces the same LY_1201 group with LY_1204; the last selected H12 replacement wins, and its persistent DMG_RES -1000 buff clamps to zero for restored representative targets. Target account stars remain externally unknown, so reconstruction baselines conservatively default H01/H12 to 1. Unsupported effect handlers remain excluded rather than producing unverified inert cards.
